title: WAT Hour-Manifest — wakir-wat-manifest/v1 wire-form
description: JSON-Schema for the wakir-wat-manifest/v1 wire-form, i.e. the on-disk shape emitted by wat/aggregator.py and stored under .runtime/wat-tv*-archive/<RUN>/<HOUR>/manifest.json. This schema-file is the v1 sibling of wat-manifest-v2.json. It is the contract with external verifier implementers and is the source-of-truth pin for the eight mandatory fields plus the optional anchor_height / prev_hour_root extensions. v2 (multi-cap) is intentionally a separate schema file: v1 manifests carry leaves as objects (with leaf_hash, payload_hash, etc.), whereas v2 carries leaves as hex strings; the two cannot be unified without lossy coercion. Domain field-by-field descriptions track docs/wat-manifest-v2-spec.md §10 (the manifest-version field's enum surface is documented there). 0.2.0 (Phase-2 Sprint-5 Tag-5) adds an additive optional top-level `signature` slot (Ed25519 detached-signature block) byte-for-byte identical to the wat-manifest-v2 schema 0.2.0 signature slot; absence is permitted (the Production aggregator does not emit signed manifests today). The optional slot is what enables `verify_real_manifest_file(verify_signature=True, ...)` to consume hand-signed real-manifest fixtures and (later) the signing-aggregator branch output through the same pipeline. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

version.description: Manifest version discriminator. v1 hours emit 'wakir-wat-manifest/v1' verbatim. The future v2 producer (wat/aggregator.py v2 branch) will emit 'wakir-wat-manifest/v2' once it lands; until then the v2 string is reserved here so the schema accepts both readings without a separate file. Verifier code path (verify_real_manifest_file) recognises the same set; see _REAL_VERSIONS in wat/verify/manifest_v2.py.

hour_slot.description: UTC hour slot in YYYY-MM-DDTHH form. Same shape as the v2 schema and TV-1/TV-2/TV-3 driver harnesses; aggregator emits this string as the natural-key for the archive directory.

merkle_root.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical Merkle root over the events[]/leaves[] for this hour. The merkle_root is what gets OTS-stamped against the public Bitcoin calendar substrate; root.bin (32 raw bytes equal to bytes.fromhex(merkle_root)) sits next to manifest.json and root.bin.ots is its OpenTimestamps proof.

event_count.description: Number of audit-event frames ingested for this hour. Equal to len(events) and len(leaves). Verifier rejects on drift between this field and the array lengths.

event_id.description: Producer-assigned event identifier. Stable across the manifest lifecycle.

time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the event entered the aggregator. Part of the leaf-hash B1-tuple.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical event payload. Part of the leaf-hash B1-tuple.

capability_token_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the capability-token reference. Part of the leaf-hash B1-tuple. v1 manifests carry exactly one capref per event in this projected field; v2 manifests carry caprefs[] separately under multi_cap_events (see wat-manifest-v2.json).

leaf_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical leaf computed from the B1-tuple. Verifier cross-checks this against the recomputed value during integrity-rebuild.

events.description: Per-event metadata array. Each item carries the B1-tuple plus leaf_hash. v1-shape uses leaf_hash (NOT leaf as in the v2 schema); the verifier's _check_real_event_leaves accepts either field name for forward-compat with the future v2 producer.

oneOf.description: v2-spec shape: ordered SHA-256 leaf hashes feeding the Merkle tree, one per event.

leaf_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical leaf for this event. The verifier's _normalise_real_leaves extracts this field when the entry is an object.

oneOf.description: v1-aggregator shape: leaves[i] is a full event-shaped object carrying at minimum leaf_hash (the actual aggregator emits the full B1-tuple here verbatim, hence additionalProperties: true). Verifier normalises both shapes onto a unified hex-string list before Merkle rebuild.

leaves.description: Ordered leaves array. v1 aggregator emits per-event objects with leaf_hash; v2 spec emits hex strings. Both shapes are accepted; verifier normalises before Merkle rebuild.

tree_levels.description: Reconstructable Merkle tree levels (leaves at index 0, root at last index). Used for inclusion-proof rebuilding by the verifier without re-walking the leaves. Verifier rejects on shape or node-hash drift.

build_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the manifest was constructed by the aggregator. Informational only; not part of the merkle_root computation.

anchor_height.description: Optional. Bitcoin block-height at which the merkle_root anchor confirmed. Today (Sprint-2 Tag-6) the v1 aggregator does not emit this field; it is reserved for a future TV-pin-pack-aggregator update that pins the actual block-height post-confirmation. Verifier accepts any positive integer when present and rejects non-positive values.

oneOf.description: SHA-256 hex of the previous hour's merkle_root, when one exists.
Null on the first hour of an aggregator run, where there is no predecessor.

prev_hour_root.description: Optional chain-pointer to the previous hour. Aggregator emits null on the first hour and the previous merkle_root hex on subsequent hours. Not currently consulted by the verifier; reserved for future hour-chain integrity checks.

signature.description: Optional detached Ed25519 signature block over the canonical (JCS-canonicalised, SHA-256-hashed) manifest payload with the `signature` slot removed. Additive on the wakir-wat-manifest/v1 wire-form (Phase-2 Sprint-5 Tag-5, schema 0.2.0). Absence is permitted: the Production aggregator does not emit signed manifests today. Slot shape is byte-identical to the wat-manifest-v2 schema 0.2.0 signature slot (Sprint-5 Tag-1), wirelang.identity.aip_signing.SIGNATURE_BLOCK, wirelang.schemas.entry_signing._validate_signature_block_shape, and wat.identity.manifest_signing.SIGNATURE_FIELD. The kid field references an AIP-document public_keys entry under PURPOSE_WAT_ANCHOR; the resolver bridge is wat.identity.anchor_kid.resolve_wat_anchor_kid (Sprint-4 Tag-5). The signing primitive (wat.identity.manifest_signing.sign_manifest, Sprint-4 Tag-6) emits exactly this shape. The verifier consumer is verify_real_manifest_file(verify_signature=True, ...).

alg.description: Signature algorithm identifier. Closed enum: only Ed25519 is accepted today; future algorithm support requires a coordinated additive schema bump and a parallel allowlist entry in wat.identity.manifest_signing.SIGNATURE_ALG.

kid.description: Key identifier. Non-empty string. Caller binds this to an AIP-document public_keys entry under PURPOSE_WAT_ANCHOR (see wat.identity.anchor_kid).

signature.description: Ed25519 detached signature, 64 bytes encoded as 128 lowercase hex chars. Pre-image: SHA-256 of the RFC-8785 JCS canonicalisation of the manifest payload with this `signature` slot stripped.
